'''Imperial Palaces''' were [[Monument]]s constructed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[ASP-7 labor droid/Legends|ASP-7 labor droids]] built them for a cost of 3000 units each of [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]], [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]], and [[Ore/Legends|ore]]. They had a square base and one entrance was in the front of the Palace's tower. It also possessed two spheres, as well as a statue of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. One Imperial Palace was built on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] in the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] after the Empire [[Occupation of Bespin|took control]] of the [[City/Legends|city]]. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Hindane Darcc/Legends|Hindane Darcc]] had his own [[Darcc's Palace|palace]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], which was [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|destroyed]] by a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Army/Legends|army]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Behind the scenes==
Imperial Palaces are the Galactic Empire Monument buildings in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. One must be built during the [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] campaign during the Cloud City Attack mission. Another one appears in the Chewbacca campaign, which must be destroyed. Building an Imperial Palace and defending it for a set period of time is a way to win skirmish missions. They may also be built during multiplayer in the game's [[2002]] expansion pack, [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']].

Because of the Imperial Palace monument's design being reused for ''the'' [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the design of the Imperial Palace was significantly different compared to most depictions.
